about_the_game:
​​​
Ms Vampire Love to Date with Me is a multi-ending romance-raising ADV that simulates protagonist Tang Jun’s 30-day cohabitation with Irene, a self-proclaimed vampire girlfriend, in a castle. Despite Tang Jun having no memory of her, Irene insists they are lovers. Players must interact with her to stabilize her emotional and physical states while uncovering the truth she hides. Over 30 days, players may face catastrophic endings. Only by discovering Irene’s secrets and surviving until the end can players make their own choice based on memories forged with her.

​
As a senior college student, you wake up in a lavish, unfamiliar castle. Lifting your head, you meet the gaze of a dreamlike beauty smiling down at you.
“I’m your girlfriend, Irene!”
Though she claims to be ordinary, her nocturnal habits and occasional thirst for your blood hint at something darker. Visions of bloody scenes in your mind suggest the castle harbors terrifying secrets. Despite her flawless façade as a girlfriend, a grim预感 lingers: failing to meet her romantic expectations might turn those visions into reality. Thus, you play the role of her lover while searching for the hidden truth…

​Irene Myula:​​
​

​
A mysterious girl who yearns to experience a romantic life with the protagonist. Outgoing only toward him. Loves new experiences, physical activities, classical music, garden walks, hot cocoa, and “couple activities.”
She seems like the perfect girlfriend—if you indulge her romantic fantasies. But mention breaking up, and something horrifying might occur…

​
​​Daytime​​ is for coexisting with Irene in the castle. Spend time with her to nurture her skills or let her drink blood to relieve fatigue. Irene improves through effort, discovering new joys as her abilities grow.

​​Nighttime​​ is when Irene is most energetic. She hopes to date you, though the final plans rest with you. Dates leverage skills cultivated during the day, deepening your bond. As her abilities grow, dates unlock unique events, creating cherished memories for Irene.

​
​​卢隆制作组​​
Planning/Scenario/Music: 老左
Planning/Programming: 珈百璃
Art: 一文字
